map.不同介质（空气、水、钢）声速不同，λ=c/f 随之变化。: Sound speed differs across media (air, water, steel), so lambda=c/f changes accordingly.
map.超声在介质中的波长决定分辨率与穿透。: The wavelength of ultrasound in a medium determines resolution and penetration.

map.水中声速 c≈1480 m/s、f=100 kHz，λ=1480/1e5=0.0: In water c=1480 m/s, f=100 kHz gives lambda=1480/1e5=0.0148 m=14.8 mm, far shorter than in air at the same frequency.
map.同频声波在不同介质波长一样吗？: Is the wavelength the same across media at a fixed frequency?
map.不一样：波长取决于介质声速，水中声速约为空气 4.3 倍，同频波长也约 4.3: No: wavelength depends on the medium's speed; water conducts sound about 4.3x faster than air, so the same frequency gives about 4.3x the wavelength.
map.为什么超声成像看分辨率看波长？: Why does ultrasound imaging resolution come down to wavelength?
map.分辨率约为一个波长量级，波长越短（频率越高）分辨细节越细。: Resolution is roughly one wavelength, so the shorter the wavelength (higher the frequency) the finer the detail resolved.
